description: This PHP source file defines the ChannelCriteriaAdminController class, which manages administrative actions related to channel criteria in a web application. It includes route definitions, questionnaire management, and data export functionalities for channels.

classes.name: ChannelCriteriaAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing channel criteria, including questionnaire handling and CSV export. Inherits from AbstractAdminController.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for this controller, 'channels'.

methods.name: getRoutes

methods.name: saveQuestionnaire
methods.description: Processes and saves questionnaire data received from a request.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays and manages the questionnaire for a specified channel ID, including adding and removing questions.

methods.name: exportAction
methods.description: Exports channel-related questionnaire responses and project data as a CSV stream.
